subject.title: feat(ui): session board grid engine and board view

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor and merge this standalone board-rendering layer now, before the dashboard host and gateway protocol that define its durable contract are ready?
rationale: The branch adds a new session-dashboard capability with temporary local types and no normal product entry point; choosing whether this intermediate contract is an acceptable core boundary requires maintainer product and ownership intent.

options.title: Sponsor the staged board core
options.body: Confirm the local board contract as the approved interim boundary, require MCP-app and fixture proof on the final head, then review this PR alongside the host/protocol follow-ups.

options.title: Sequence with the durable contract
options.body: Hold this PR until the dashboard host and gateway protocol can define and validate the board contract together, avoiding a temporary public-adjacent shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged board core
recommendation.body: Confirm the local board contract as the approved interim boundary, require MCP-app and fixture proof on the final head, then review this PR alongside the host/protocol follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history identifies steipete as the active contributor coordinating both the board core and linked dashboard-shell work; a repository owner should make the final sponsorship decision.
